source_refs.title: How to scan documents on your iPhone or iPad - Apple Support
source_refs.applicability: iPhone; the flash and image filter options apply only to iOS 26 as the page states
source_refs.verified_excerpt: If your device is in Auto mode, your document will automatically scan.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: Open Notes and select a note or create a new one. Tap the Attachment button, then tap Scan Documents. Position the document in front of the camera. If your device is in Auto mode, your document will automatically scan. Otherwise, tap the Shutter button or press a Volume button. Drag the corners to adjust the scan to fit the page, then tap Keep Scan. Tap the Done button, or add more scans to the document. In iOS 26, you can also select options such as flash or an image filter. Alternatively, in an open note, tap the More button, then tap Scan.

source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: In the Files app, tap the More button. Tap Scan Documents. Position the document in front of the camera. If your device is in Auto mode, your document will automatically scan. Otherwise, tap the Shutter button or press a Volume button. Drag the corners to adjust the scan to fit the page, then tap Keep Scan. Tap the Done button, or add more scans. Choose a location, then tap Save. In iOS 26, you can also select options such as flash or an image filter.
